summary.text: Ben McGorty, a Republican, has represented Connecticut House District 122 since July 25, 2014.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Greenwich, Connecticut, and earned an associate degree in management from Housatonic Community College in 2004.

His career history includes work as a realtor, and he has served as a lieutenant and deputy fire marshal for the town of Stratford, a fire commissioner for Shelton, a firefighter with the Huntington Fire Department, and an EMT.
